request.style: English, warm female solo voice, gentle piano, soft strings, acoustic guitar, light percussion, soulful and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Blessed are the merciful
They will receive mercy
A gentle heart in this world
Giving what is free

[Chorus]
Blessed are the merciful
For they will receive mercy
The hand that gives freely
Is held by the Lord

[Verse]
Blessed are the pure in heart
They will see God
Clear eyes looking up
To the light above

[Chorus]
Blessed are the merciful
For they will receive mercy
The hand that gives freely
Is held by the Lord

[Bridge]
Blessed are the peacemakers
Called sons of God
Building bridges of peace
Where love is found

[Outro]
Blessed are the merciful
They will receive mercy
